issues.description: Inconsistent ABI/return convention for scalar fixed-point functions: tests declare and use fix_add_asm/fix_sub_asm as returning a single fix_t in EAX (e.g., `fix_t real = fix_add_asm(a,b);`), but the provided fix_add.asm implementation (and comments in other asm files) follow a 64-bit EDX:EAX return style. This mismatch confuses students and can lead to incorrect implementations when following the asm examples vs. the test harness expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the scalar-function ABI across materials: either (A) make fix_add_asm/fix_sub_asm/fix_mul_asm return fix_t in EAX only (update fix_add.asm implementation and the comments in fix_mul.asm/fix_sub.asm), or (B) switch tests+fix_asm.h to a 64-bit return convention (e.g., fix64_t return) and update all call sites accordingly.
